text:
Yes. Monzo’s UK personal current account can receive your salary and pay bills by Direct Debit and standing order, so you can use it as your main account. You can give your employer your Monzo account details, or switch using the Current Account Switch Service, which moves your balance and regular payments and redirects payments sent to your old account. A full switch usually takes seven working days and closes your old account.

A few things to weigh up:

- **Cash:** deposits are limited to £750 a month and usually cost £1 per deposit.
- **Savings protection:** eligible deposits are covered by the FSCS up to £120,000 per person.
- **If you’re switching:** check any payments or services that use your old card details separately; they may need updating.

If you rely on depositing lots of cash or want a backup account, you could keep another bank account open rather than doing a full switch.
